cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to eye level and performs a rhythmic side-to-side waving motion to greet someone.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm moves upward to a high position, holds briefly to signal attention or acknowledgement, and then stays at that expressive peak.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot arm moves to a high neutral position, then slowly lowers and leans forward while tilting the gripper downward to perform a respectful formal bow.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward at chest height with the gripper oriented vertically, finishing with a small inviting bob to signal readiness for a handshake.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward at chest height with a vertical gripper orientation and performs a rhythmic up-and-down shaking motion.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm sweeps across its chest to the opposite shoulder, pointing the gripper inward and performing a gentle rhythmic squeeze to simulate a self-hugging gesture of comfort.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot moves its hand to its mouth area, pauses briefly, then sweeps its arm forward and upward in a graceful arc while flicking its wrist to release a kiss.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm moves high above the head and traces a large, continuous heart shape in the air to express love or affection.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot moves its hand in a gentle arc to rest against its chest, signaling sincerity, gratitude, or a heartfelt sentiment.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The arm starts at chest level with the gripper pointing up, thrusts rapidly to a high position, and performs several quick vertical pumps to signal triumph.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot celebrates by raising its gripper to chest height and then pumping it downward forcefully in a sharp, triumphant motion.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot extends its arm laterally before curling it toward its head in a powerful bicep flex, punctuated by a brief tensing shake to signal strength.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot arm positions its gripper at eye level facing forward and performs a rhythmic vertical nodding motion with the wrist to signal agreement or affirmation.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot raises its gripper to eye level and performs a rapid side-to-side rotation of the wrist to mimic a human shaking their head 'no'.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot indicates uncertainty by quickly raising its shoulders while the grippers are oriented horizontally and facing upward, followed by a slight outward flare of the arms.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot moves its gripper to the side of its head (temple area) and performs a series of rapid, small movements to simulate scratching in a gesture of confusion.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot positions its gripper at eye level looking forward, then slowly tilts its 'head' to the side and holds the position, mimicking a human expression of inquisitive interest.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot quickly brings its gripper to its forehead with the palm facing inward, signaling embarrassment, disbelief, or intense frustration.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot moves its arm to chest height and points the gripper inward toward its own body to indicate self-reference.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot draws its arm back toward its chest and then thrusts it forward, pointing the gripper tip directly at the person in front to indicate 'You'.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the palm facing down and repeatedly curls its wrist and elbow inward to invite someone to approach.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot quickly extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented horizontally, mimicking a flat-palm 'stop' or 'wait' gesture.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot arm sharply raises the gripper to eye level with the tip pointing upward, followed by a subtle waggle to signal attention or a request to wait.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot raises its gripper to its mouth in a vertical orientation and holds it there to signal for silence.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot moves its gripper to the stomach area, pointing inward, and performs a series of light, repetitive patting motions to signal hunger or satisfaction.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot crosses its arm over its chest to reach the opposite upper arm and performs a rapid rubbing and shivering motion to signal it is cold.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its hand to face level and performs a rapid back-and-forth fanning motion with the wrist to indicate it is feeling hot.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot raises its arm to cover its mouth area with the back of the gripper, holding the pose to simulate a yawn, followed by a slight lethargic tremble of the wrist.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot raises its arm to eye level and performs a repetitive scrubbing and circular motion against its 'eye' to indicate fatigue or waking up.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot stands at attention with hands at its sides, then executes a slow, deep, and sincere bow forward, holding the lowest position to signal a formal apology.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot positions its arm at eye level with the gripper pointing up and performs two quick 'nodding' motions with the wrist to simulate the air quotes gesture.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head and taps its 'temple' with the gripper several times to suggest thinking or intelligence.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot positions its gripper near the side of the head (temple) and performs several small, rapid circular rotations to indicate the 'crazy' gesture.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot moves its gripper to the side of its mouth and slides it horizontally across its 'lips' to represent zipping them shut, indicating a secret or a promise of silence.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot arm moves in a sharp, horizontal sweep across the torso, ending with the gripper tucked tightly against the chest to signal a defensive or guarded stance.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot arm flares out and then snaps firmly onto the hip with the elbow jutting outward, signaling a posture of authority or frustration.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and slightly downward to simulate a torso leaning in, while keeping the gripper horizontal and pointing forward to mimic an open, receptive hand gesture.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot arm recoils sharply toward the chest with the gripper facing forward in a defensive 'stop' gesture, including a brief nervous tremble before freezing in surprise.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: A reflexive motion where the robot arm snaps upward to cover the mouth area with the gripper, followed by a slight nervous tremor to signal surprise or embarrassment.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its gripper to the center of its chest, pointing upward to simulate pressed palms, and then performs a slow, respectful leaning arc to represent a bow of gratitude or respect.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot lifts its hand to chest level with a vertical gripper orientation, performs a sharp upward thrust to simulate a toast, and holds the 'glass' high at eye level.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and upward to eye level, orienting the gripper vertically to present a flat palm. It then performs a slight forward nudge to clearly invite a high five interaction.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot raises its arm high with the gripper oriented horizontally to mimic a palm, pauses, then swings it rapidly downward in an arc, stopping abruptly at chest level to simulate a high-five impact.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot lifts its gripper to chest height in a vertical orientation and extends it forward in a linear path, finishing with a slight forward nudge to invite a fist bump.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot positions its arm at chest height and executes two quick forward-and-back pulses to mimic tapping a fist against a palm.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot raises its arm to shoulder height and turns the gripper toward itself, then performs a series of gentle tapping motions against its upper back to signal self-approval or encouragement.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and uses its wrist and elbow to trace three continuous circular loops in the air, signaling to repeat an action or go around something.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot raises its gripper to throat level in a horizontal orientation and executes a sharp, rapid horizontal slice across the neck area, finishing with an emphatic hold.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot brings its hand under its chin with the gripper pointing back toward its body, then performs a sharp, fast outward flicking motion to signal dismissal or indifference.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot positions its arm as if resting on a surface and performs rapid, rhythmic wrist oscillations to simulate drumming fingers impatiently.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm forward at waist height with the palm facing up, then performs a repetitive beckoning motion by curling its wrist inward to request an object.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot moves its gripper to a horizontal orientation near its chest and extends it forward in a smooth, steady line, holding the final position to signal an offering or presentation.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to a high position beside its head with the gripper pointing up and the opening facing forward, holding the posture to signal submission.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to the side of its head and presses its gripper against its temple area with a slight shudder, signaling a reaction to excessive noise.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot moves its arm to the center chest and then sweeps it outward in a broad, horizontal arc to a wide-open posture, holding the position to signal a warm welcome.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot simulates a deep morning stretch by slowly raising its arm from chest height to a maximum vertical extension, followed by a subtle vibrating movement to represent muscle tension and relief.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot executes a crisp, high-speed military salute by snapping its gripper to the temple with a horizontal orientation and holding the position firmly.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot places its gripper horizontally against its forehead like a visor and performs a slow lateral sweep to simulate searching the horizon for something far away.
